assumptions: The screens are CHOPCHOP's, with the Thyme 2016 thresholds and backbones.
limits: A screen explains a dead guide; passing it does not predict activity.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which guide spacers fail the pre-acceptance screens: GC, self-complementary hairpins, and hairpins against the sgRNA backbone?

description: Screen guide spacers the way CHOPCHOP does before it accepts them: GC gate, self-complementary hairpins inside the spacer, and hairpins against the sgRNA backbone. A guide that folds onto its own scaffold is loaded into Cas9 poorly however good its on-target score is, so this is the check that explains a guide with a good score and no activity.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

backbone.description: which sgRNA backbone the spacer will be cloned into — the hairpin test is against this. Values: original (original gRNA backbone), extended (extended backbone (Cas9-GFP tracking)).

gg.description: the construct starts the transcript GG — upstream's `-gg` REPLACES the spacer's first two bases with G (T7 preference), it does not lengthen it. Advanced.

pre_g.description: the construct prepends a single 5' G (upstream's `-preG`) — this one lengthens the scanned string, and upstream's fixed 17-window loop then never reaches its last bases. Advanced.

spacers.description: the protospacers to screen (20 nt for SpCas9) — wire `topSpacer` or the spacers out of a design run, or list them.

name: screen_guides

backboneLabel.description: which backbone the run screened against

clean.description: the spacers that passed the GC gate and flagged no hairpin — the ones to take forward

counts.description: upstream's own four summary counts: total, after the GC screen, with a self hairpin, with a backbone hairpin

screened.description: per spacer: GC, whether it was dropped by the GC gate, the two hairpin verdicts, and every flagged 4-mer with its position
